summary: Use retained HTML/XML serialization runtime for innerHTML reads.

semantics.escaping: serialization escapes/normalizes according to HTML/XML algorithms
semantics.shadow_dom: serialization rules differ and shadow roots are not ordinary descendants

caveats: String caching/source preservation is incorrect; serialization is derived from the current DOM tree.
references: WHATWG HTML Standard § innerHTML / HTML serialization

tests.name: serializes current DOM state
tests.input: const e=document.createElement('div'); const b=document.createElement('b'); b.textContent='<'; e.append(b); console.log(e.innerHTML);
tests.expected_behavior: prints serialized markup such as < according to HTML serialization

tests.name: reflects mutations not original source
tests.expected_behavior: serialization contains b, not the original a
